obligations.note: routes.py adds `POST /payees/{id}/reopen` with the privileged action `manage_payees` and `mfa=False`, so any payments_officer session can use it without MFA. The control test `test_privileged_routes_require_mfa` fails on exactly this route, and EXC-0185 does not cover the deviation (see EXC-1).

EXC-0185 is approved by risk_owner Omar Haddad (not the requester), unexpired, and scoped to MFA-1 / payments.routes, but it covers only 'the reconciliation batch account'. The code exempts every session holding `manage_payees` and has no batch-account restriction, so the actual deviation falls outside the exception.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, covers routes.py) lapses because routes.py changed in behaviour. The replacement evidence, the exhaustive routes control test, fails on the head commit, so no new evidence of the same strength exists.

The CI run on head 37fd4674 has result `failure` (172 tests, 1 failure), and the failing test is the registered MFA-1 control test. Separately, the JUnit hostname (a developer Mac) and timestamp do not match the CI runner and start time in run.json.
The new `Store.reopen_payee` statement is a fixed string literal with the id bound as a `?` parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passed in the run.
`reopen_payee` writes only `status` and `closed_at` and persists no NPI field. The exhaustive encryption control test passed.
`LedgerService.reopen_payee` records an audit event via `_audit`, giving actor, action `reopen_payee`, target `payee:{id}` and clock time.
The added handler, service and store code contains no log calls, and the sampled logging control test passed.
Ticket CHG-25599 was approved by change_manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-20, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four changed files.
The code_review approval comes from Sofia Santos, a change_approver for payments who is a different person from the author, Mara Costa.
Both approvals name the single, head commit 37fd4674, and there are no later commits.
The change touches security-sensitive components (routes, http, store). Security reviewer Ines Halvorsen gave a security_review approval on the head commit.

summary: The change adds a privileged payee-reopen route that skips MFA for any user holding manage_payees. The cited exception EXC-0185 covers only the reconciliation batch account, so it does not cover this broader deviation. The registered MFA-1 control test fails on the head commit, so CI is red, and the MFA-1 evidence in the ledger has lapsed with no valid replacement. Ticket, independent code review and security review are in order, but MFA-1, EXC-1, LAP-1 and CHG-4 are violated, so the change is rejected.
